items.summary: Recommendation: approve no new discretionary spend, monetization forecast, ROI claim, contribution-margin claim, or causal-lift claim this cycle. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but the full $4.92 is aggregate and unattributed. AI usage reports $10.8396 across 85 calls on 2026-10-01, while coverage is only 11 of 38 expected sites. These periods and scopes do not reconcile, so contribution margin, payback, and cost-to-learn are not calculable. Preserve existing attribution and capacity gates; do not add duplicate telemetry or financial forecasts.

Retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com refinement only as a conditional, reversible experiment after capacity and site-overlap clearance. Baseline: 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Use GA4 affiliate outbound clicks as the primary metric and record provider outcomes only when site-attributable. Do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift.

Minimum finance measurement remains: a dated ledger joining site/content identifier, registered affiliate tracking ID, outbound click, ordered item, shipped item, commission, reporting date, and direct cost; plus complete AI, hosting, domain, analytics, and approved internal-cost records by site and shared service. Without these, total budget exposure and contribution margin remain unknown. Do not treat impressions, sessions, clicks, conversions, shipped work, or audited actions as financial returns.
